== Original and remastered English issuer text ==
The remaster raises the pilot power bonus from 2 to 3, or from 3 to 4 aboard Falcon. Falcon retains its maneuver bonus, the fallback destiny draw and the protection against opponent modification, cancellation or reset of destiny draws and total at the same system.
